question: What exact fields, disclosure language, provider-transmission boundary, and unavailable/denied/no-data semantics should define the approved `health.summary` contract?
rationale: The related maintainer decision already supports bounded authenticated node commands, but source inspection cannot authorize the final minimization and disclosure rules for sensitive health information.

options.title: Approve the proposed fixed contract
options.body: Allow only steps, asleep duration, average resting heart rate, and workout count/duration for `today`, `7d`, or `30d`, with no raw samples, sources, metadata, writes, or background collection.

options.title: Narrow the first release
options.body: Start with steps and workout totals and defer sleep and resting heart rate until privacy and App Review evidence is stronger.

options.title: Pause HealthKit work
options.body: Defer implementation until OpenClaw has a broader companion-app policy for sensitive personal data sent to model providers.

recommendation.title: Approve the proposed fixed contract
recommendation.body: Allow only steps, asleep duration, average resting heart rate, and workout count/duration for `today`, `7d`, or `30d`, with no raw samples, sources, metadata, writes, or background collection.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns this issue and authored the related maintainer decision selecting the bounded node/Gateway architecture, so he is the strongest available owner for the remaining contract choice.
